scenes.text: Imagine opening the most sacred book in the world, only to find a commandment that actually orders you to cheat on your partner.
In 1631, a royal printer made a disastrous typo in the Ten Commandments, accidentally printing, 'Thou shalt commit adultery'.
The furious King ordered all copies of this 'Wicked Bible' to be gathered and burned, ruining the printers forever.
Only fifteen copies survived the fire and are now worth a fortune, so tell us if you would keep one and subscribe for more!
